# TP-Link JetStream fixtures (SYNTHETIC)

TP-Link's CLI reference guides document command syntax but show no command output. These
files reproduce the JetStream firmware layout as closely as known (T2600G-28TS v3, firmware
3.0.x) and exist so the parsers have something to run against. Replace each file with a real
capture (`terminal length 0` session, same command) before relying on the TP-Link parsers;
see docs/HARDWARE_VALIDATION.md.
